title: dig-search surface contract
description: The single published contract for driving dig-search.ts — the K-hole construct's one executable entry point. A human or an agent reads this file (or runs `dig-search.ts --print-contract`) and knows how to operate the tool with zero source-reading. The four primitives — BREADTH, DEPTH, PULLING-THREADS, RESONANCE — are expressed as flags on this one entry point; there are no sibling scripts that duplicate a primitive.

breadth.what: a fast wide shallow pass — 'is this question pointed at the right space?'

depth.what: intentional descent into one thread, N angles deep

pulling-threads.what: a dig's surfaced threads become the next dig's seeds — the loop

resonance.what: how strongly a reference/thread grounds a direction — governs which threads pull hardest

description-inputs: CLI flags. `properties` below is the input contract. --query is the only required input.

query.description: The thread to dig. Required. A phrase, finding, or question — already half-synthesized; the construct follows the pull.

depth.description: DEPTH. 1-4 search angles; depth 0 is 'Lilly's tank' (synthesis-only, no search). Mutually exclusive with --scout.

scout.description: BREADTH. One search, no synthesis — source list + one-line gist per source. Mutually exclusive with --depth.

stream.description: DEPTH visibility. stdout becomes NDJSON: one search/search_error event per completed search + a terminal `complete` event. Without it, stdout is the single JSON blob.

envelopes.description: PULLING-THREADS (consume). A creative-resonance-envelope JSON file or a directory of them; their threads_to_pull seed the dig. Seeds never crowd out the query (ceil(depth/2) slots reserved).

no-emit-envelope.description: PULLING-THREADS (emit). Opt out of the default: every deep dig with a --trail auto-emits a candidate creative-resonance-envelope.

resonance.description: RESONANCE. A resonance profile file — weights which connections the synthesis surfaces.

trail.description: A dig-session trail file. Deep digs append to it; envelope emission writes to <trail-dir>/envelopes/. No --trail means no emission.

model.description: Override the search model (default gemini-3-pro-preview; aliases resolved).

print-contract.description: Print this surface contract to stdout and exit 0. For agent self-discovery.

help.description: Print a human-readable usage summary and exit 0.

x-flag-combinations.behavior: --stream has no effect in scout mode (scout is one call, no progressive events); accepted, no error
scout does not consume seeds; --envelopes is ignored in scout mode
scout has no side effects — no trail append, no envelope emission
depth 1 reserves its single slot for the query; seeds are ignored with a stderr note
no --trail already means no emission; harmless
fully compose — a streamed, envelope-seeded, trail-writing deep dig

x-output-shapes.scout: { mode:'scout', query, sources:[{title,url,gist,gist_quality}], source_count, elapsed_s, note }
x-output-shapes.deep-dig (non-stream): single JSON blob: { query, depth_rating, findings, emergence, pull_threads, synthesis, sources, source_count, search_count, failed_searches, web_search_queries, had_resonance, had_trail, trail_file, emitted_envelope }
x-output-shapes.deep-dig (--stream): NDJSON: { event:'search', query_index, of, query, source_count, elapsed_ms } | { event:'search_error', query_index, of, query, error } | { event:'complete', ...<the deep-dig blob> }
x-output-shapes.partial (SIGINT/SIGTERM): { partial:true, query, completed_searches, failed_searches, total_searches, sources, synthesis:null, reason }
x-output-shapes.emitted-envelope: conforms to creative-resonance-envelope.schema.json — written to <trail-dir>/envelopes/<envelope_id>.json, provenance.candidate:true

x-exit-codes.1: runtime error (e.g. all searches failed, missing --query, no provider configured)
x-exit-codes.130: aborted by SIGINT — partial artifact flushed to stdout
x-exit-codes.143: aborted by SIGTERM — partial artifact flushed to stdout

x-test-seams.DIG_MOCK_PROVIDER: path to a fixture — mocks gemini() with canned GeminiResponse data (keyed map supported; __error / __delay_ms / __synthesis / __default entries)
x-test-seams.DIG_DUMP_STATE: path — dumps { accumulator, failed_searches } after a run for test observability
x-test-seams.DIG_CLI_BIN: override the gemini CLI binary — points geminiCliCall's spawn at a test double
x-test-seams.note: production never sets these — they exist so the suite can exercise the full real CLI path with zero API/subscription spend
